edit.description: explain of a requirement narrates its verifier; review as held by review: <prose>, none as unheld

summary: explain of a requirement names what holds it: held by review with the reader's prose, the script or telemetry verifier, or unheld when none is declared

per.section: requirement — a shipped kind, not a primitive

acceptance: explain on a review-held requirement prints held by review and its prose; on one with no verifier prints unheld; check's verdict is unchanged by either
tests: explain names a review held requirements reader
explain names a requirement with no verifier as unheld
notes: 0095 Consequences. Unheld is narration, never a finding: no default clause (intent invariant 1).
